subtitle: Your network, mapped
promotionalText: Who needs you this week, who changed jobs, and your best way into any company. Private by design: no account, no server.
description:
Bearings turns your LinkedIn export into a private, living map of the people you know, so you always know where you stand and who to reach out to.

KNOW WHO NEEDS YOU
• Today opens on the people worth your time this week, each with one reason and one tap to reply, congratulate or check in
• See who wrote last and is waiting on your reply
• Spot good relationships that are going cold
• Keep-in-touch circles: monthly, quarterly or yearly, with a nudge when someone is overdue
• Catch up on new connections and job changes with a quick swipe

SEE EVERY COMPANY
• Who you know at each company, agency or command, at every level from executive to staff
• Coverage gaps on your watchlist, like no director-level contact yet
• Ways in: your best paths into any company, with the intro ask drafted
• Team packs: pool networks with teammates to find warm paths, never sharing notes or messages

TRAVEL AND EVENTS
• A map of where your people are, worked out on your iPhone
• Trips from your calendar, with who you know nearby on your Lock Screen
• Arrival alerts: land in a new city and see who you know there
• Event mode: see who you know at a conference, scan cards, and work the follow-up list

WALK INTO MEETINGS PREPARED
• A brief 30 minutes before meetings with people you know, written on-device

EXPLORE YOUR NETWORK
• The compass: your whole network by sector and closeness
• Plain-English search like “navy o-5 and up in cyber”
• An optional federal and military view with branch, rank, agency and segment
• Your year in review, ready to share

ENRICH WITH YOUR OWN DATA PROVIDER
• Sign in with your Seamless.AI account, or add your ZoomInfo API login, to fill in work email, phone and city for the people you pick
• Or import an enrichment file from any provider

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• iPhone, iPad and Mac, synced through your own iCloud
• Apple Watch app, widgets and Siri

BEARINGS PRO
The map, Today, search, Catch Up, reminders, widgets and Watch are free. Bearings Pro adds event mode, ways in, team packs, arrival alerts, ZoomInfo and Seamless.AI, account maps and Salesforce. Monthly or yearly subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your App Store settings; a one-time lifetime option is also available. Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no Bearings server. Your network lives on your devices and in your own iCloud. Contacts, calendar and location are read on your device and never uploaded. No ads, no tracking.

To start, request your data from LinkedIn (Settings, Data privacy, Get a copy of your data, then tick Connections, Messages and Invitations) and open the zip in Bearings. It usually takes about ten minutes.

review.notes:
Thank you for reviewing Bearings.

NO ACCOUNT OR LOGIN. Bearings has no account and no server. On first launch it opens a built-in sample network (680 fictional people) so every screen can be reviewed without any personal data. On the welcome screens, choose “Just look around a sample network.”

HOW REAL USERS GET DATA. LinkedIn lets members download their own data (Settings > Data privacy > Get a copy of your data). The user shares that ZIP or Connections.csv to Bearings, or picks it in Import. Everything is parsed on the device. Nothing is uploaded. There is no scraping and no use of LinkedIn's API.

PERMISSIONS, ALL OPTIONAL AND ASKED IN CONTEXT:
- Contacts: to start a network from Contacts before the LinkedIn file arrives, to add birthdays, and to place people on the map. Read on device only.
- Calendar: to brief the user before meetings with people they know and to spot trips. Read on device only.
- Location (when in use): Near Me on the map.
- Camera: scanning a business card at an event (text is read on device with Vision).
- Notifications: follow-up reminders and the Monday brief.

SYNC. Data syncs only through the user's own iCloud (CloudKit/iCloud Documents). Optional Salesforce integration signs in directly with the user's Salesforce org via OAuth and is off by default.

ENRICHMENT (OPTIONAL). Users who already have a ZoomInfo or Seamless.AI account can add their own API credentials in Settings. Only when they tap Look up, the selected people's names and companies are sent from the device to that provider to fetch work email, phone, title and city. Credentials stay in the device Keychain. Off by default; no Bearings server is involved.

AI. Briefs and draft messages use Apple's on-device Foundation Models when available, with a plain template fallback. No third-party AI service.

Privacy policy: https://www.jaynichols.net/bearings/privacy.html
